title: IDPC Decision 2026: CCTV camera capturing a workplace canteen area.
text:
Type: Data Protection Complaint

Description: CCTV camera capturing a workplace canteen area.

Outcome: The controller could not validly rely on article 6(1)(f) of the Regulation as a legal basis for the processing activity. The controller further failed to effectively demonstrate that such processing is based on one of the legal bases set out in article 6(1) of the Regulation. Infringement of article 5(2) and article 6(1) GDPR.

Corrective Action: Reprimand in terms of article 58(2)(b) GDPR & Order in terms of article 58(2)(f) GDPR.
